character_dna.name: Kael
character_dna.description: A sharp 30-year-old street detective wearing a weathered high-collar trench coat with subtle neon cyan LED trim, dark tactical boots, and cybernetic optical monocle reflecting holographic billboards.
character_dna.acting: Cool, calculated, stealthy, and quick on his feet. Sprints across rain-slicked neon alleys, slides beneath laser security fences, and decodes encrypted memory chips under streetlamps.

world_rules.setting: Callejones lluviosos de una metrópolis cyberpunk del año 2099, rascacielos con hologramas gigantes y mercados subterráneos de tecnología.
world_rules.tone: Micro-thriller neo-noir a contrarreloj de 30 segundos, tensión de sigilo, reflejos de neón y escape vertiginoso.

visual_style: Blade Runner inspired cinematic live-action, 50mm f/1.4 lens, wet asphalt reflections, neon magenta and cyan rim lighting, atmospheric steam and rain bokeh.
tiktok_default_caption: ¡Misión de extracción en los callejones prohibidos de Neo-Tokio! 🌧️🌆⚡
